verified_facts.text: The hotel is close to the gardens of Villa Borghese and the Galleria Borghese, Piazza di Spagna, Via dei Condotti and the Trevi Fountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our location is not precious only for its proximity to the gardens of Villa Borghese and the Galleria Borghese, Piazza di Spagna, Via dei Condotti and the Trevi Fountain.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on Via Veneto, the street made famous by Fellini's La Dolce Vita, a short walk from Harry's Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: an image of Italy was born — the one Fellini's La Dolce Vita made famous around the world. On those nights, the most glamorous in Rome, the Regina was here, just a short walk from the iconic Harry's Bar.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has witnessed more than a century of Roman life.
verified_facts.excerpt: A witness to more than a century of Roman life, Baglioni Hotel Regina

verified_facts.text: Rooms have furnishings made to measure by Molteni&C and Rubelli curtains.
verified_facts.excerpt: furnishings designed to measure by Molteni&C, Rubelli curtains and new lamps with clean, essential lines

verified_facts.text: Interiors use marble, alabaster, fine woods and boiserie, set within the nineteenth-century proportions of the palazzo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marble, alabaster, fine woods and boiserie compose contemporary interiors, in dialogue with the nineteenth-century proportions of the palazzo

verified_facts.text: The Roman Penthouse has a multi-level panoramic terrace with a Jacuzzi and a private gym.
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by glass walls and by a spectacular multi-level panoramic terrace with Jacuzzi and private gym

verified_facts.text: The Dolce Vita Suite has floors in black marble.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious and evocative, with floors in precious black marble that give character to the interiors.

verified_facts.text: Some Junior Suites have a small balcony overlooking Via Veneto.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some feature a small balcony overlooking iconic Via Veneto

verified_facts.text: The 2-Bedroom Family Room has two connecting bedrooms and two marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two connecting bedrooms and two marble bathrooms create an elegant, harmonious setting

verified_facts.text: Small and medium-sized pets up to 15 kilos are welcome, with a supplement per stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: We welcome small/medium-sized pets (max of 15 kilos/33 lbs.) A supplement of 50€ ($54 USD) per stay Will be applied.

verified_facts.text: Superior Room bathrooms are marble with Acqua di Parma amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marble bathroom with Acqua di Parma amenities

verified_facts.text: Superior Room stays include daily breakfast at the restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Daily breakfast included at the restaurant

verified_facts.text: Superior Rooms come with a welcome bottle of wine and evening turn-down service.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Welcome bottle of wine

verified_facts.text: Primiera is the hotel's restaurant and bar on Via Veneto, reinventing Italian and Roman culinary tradition.
verified_facts.excerpt: On Via Veneto, within the elegance of the Baglioni Hotel Regina, a new address reinvents Italian and Roman culinary tradition.

verified_facts.text: Primiera is a project by the de Rosa family, built around traditional cooking with unexpected pairings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Primiera is a project by the de Rosa family, with generations of experience in hospitality and restaurants, built around traditional cooking with unexpected pairings.

verified_facts.text: Primiera's name comes from the winning hand in Italian card games.
verified_facts.excerpt: In Italian card games, the primiera is the winning hand

verified_facts.text: Primiera has a wine list of Italian, French and international labels.
verified_facts.excerpt: a wine list of Italian, French and international labels

verified_facts.text: The bar serves a snack menu of Roman and Italian classics with wine or cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the bar, Roman and Italian classics shift shape again, becoming a snack menu of quicker, playful plates.

verified_facts.text: Aura Spa has treatment rooms, a relaxation area with a hot tub, a sauna, a Turkish bath and a fitness center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy exclusive treatment rooms, a relaxation area with a charming hot tub, a sauna, Turkish bath, and a fully equipped fitness center.

verified_facts.text: Aura Spa also welcomes external guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aura Spa Also Welcomes External Guests

verified_facts.text: Hotel guests without a booked spa treatment pay a daily rate for wet-area access.
verified_facts.excerpt: For guests who have not booked a treatment, access is available at a daily rate of €35 per person.
